description: Fetches a public web page and scans its visible text plus hidden HTML (comments, hidden elements, alt/aria/meta text) for prompt injection, before your agent browses or summarizes it. Use scan_text if you already have the content and scan_tools for MCP tool definitions. Respects robots.txt and refuses private/internal hosts. Free: 30 calls/day per IP shared by scan_text, scan_url and scan_tools, with full results (max 10/min; invalid input is not counted). After that the tool returns an error with the x402 pay URL ($0.003 USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum One or Solana per call at https://api.youraitools.co/injectscan/v1/scan) or prepaid credits. Returns risk_score (0-100), verdict (safe | suspicious | malicious), flagged, categories[] {category, score, description}, findings[] with location (visible or hidden), url, finalUrl, title, hidden_html {segments_checked, flagged} and page {status, contentType}. Read-only safety signal, not a guarantee.

url.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL of a public web page, e.g. "https://example.com/post". Private, loopback and internal hosts are refused; robots.txt is respected.

name: scan_url
title: Fetch a web page and scan it for prompt injection
